bio: Tempura craftsmanship handed down from the chef’s father. The essence of tempura is respected, with just a few unique, imaginative changes added. Omakase set menus display a distinctive flair, with shrimp taking the lead role. The first piece is deep-fried rare, to elicit sweetness. Shiitake mushroom stuffed with minced shrimp pairs the bounty of mountain and ocean for a beguiling texture. Another shrimp piece, with viscera concealed within, exudes a tempting fragrance. The meal concludes with kakiage, tempura of mixed seafood and veggies, with shrimp appearing once more to take a bow. Choose a bowl that takes your fancy. Quantity can be adjusted to taste....
